segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹר שֶׁהוּא יוֹצֵא לִיסָּקֵל, וְהִקְדִּישׁוֹ בְּעָלָיו – אֵינוֹ מוּקְדָּשׁ. שְׁחָטוֹ – בְּשָׂרוֹ אָסוּר. וְאִם עַד שֶׁלֹּא נִגְמַר דִּינוֹ הִקְדִּישׁוֹ בְּעָלָיו – מוּקְדָּשׁ. וְאִם שְׁחָטוֹ – בְּשָׂרוֹ מוּתָּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «an ox that is leaving» court «to be stoned» for killing a person «and its owner» then «consecrated it, it is not» considered «consecrated,» i.e., the consecration does not take effect, since deriving benefit from the ox is prohibited and the ox is therefore worthless. If one «slaughtered it, its flesh is forbidden» to be eaten and it is prohibited to derive benefit from it. «But if its owner consecrated it before its verdict» the ox «is» considered «consecrated, and if he slaughtered it its flesh is permitted.»

segments.he: מְסָרוֹ לְשׁוֹמֵר חִנָּם וּלְשׁוֹאֵל לְנוֹשֵׂא שָׂכָר וּלְשׂוֹכֵר – נִכְנְסוּ תַּחַת הַבְּעָלִים; מוּעָד – מְשַׁלֵּם נֶזֶק שָׁלֵם, וְתָם – מְשַׁלֵּם חֲצִי נֶזֶק.
segments.en: If the owner of an ox «conveyed it to an unpaid bailee, or to a borrower,» or «to a paid bailee, or to a renter,» and it caused damage while in their custody, «they enter» into the responsibilities and liabilities «in place of the owner.» Therefore, if it was «forewarned» the bailee «pays the full» cost of the «damage, and» if it was «innocuous he pays half» the cost of «the damage.»

moves.summary: consecration and slaughter of a condemned ox

positions.claim: consecration after verdict does not take effect; before verdict it does; bailees enter in place of the owner
